FOOD OUTSIDE THE MENU

Enter food manually

Enter totals for the portion you actually ate, not per 100g. This counts toward your daily goals without changing your targets.

Leave calories blank to calculate: protein × 4 + carbs × 4 + fat × 9. Enter label calories to use that value instead. Use 0 for macros you aren't tracking.

PLAN YOUR WHOLE DAY

Your dining hall plan

1. Choose your meals and percentages. 2. Pick foods from the menu and assign them to a meal. 3. Create your full-day plan with portions in grams.

Every selected food is included in its enabled meal. Optional additions use foods offered at that dining hall and meal, favoring more of the missing macro per calorie.

How portions are calculated

Portions are fitted to calories, protein, carbs, and fat together. Each chosen food gets at least ¼ estimated serving; each dish is capped at 4 estimated servings. Weights are rounded to whole grams. Some combinations cannot meet every target—the plan shows the remaining differences. This is a macro-planning tool, not a guarantee of a nutritionally complete diet.
